+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AffineEtaleDescent

+import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Fpqc

+/-!
+# Big-etale descent for the Pic0 Sigma functor
+
+The big etale topology agrees with the quasi-compact topology generated by etale
+morphisms.  Its sheaf condition therefore reduces to Zariski descent and singleton
+surjective etale maps between affine schemes.  The latter is supplied by the affine
+Pic0 descent theorem.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
+open scoped TensorProduct
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+noncomputable section
+
+/-- The ordinary and quasi-compact presentations generate the same big etale topology. -/
+theorem Scheme.etaleTopology_eq_propQCTopology :
+    Scheme.etaleTopology.{u} = Scheme.propQCTopology (@Etale) := by
+  apply le_antisymm
+  · apply Precoverage.toGrothendieck_mono
+    rw [Scheme.propQCPrecoverage, le_inf_iff]
+    exact ⟨Scheme.precoverage_le_qcPrecoverage_of_isOpenMap
+      (fun _ _ f _ => f.isOpenMap), le_rfl⟩
+  · exact Precoverage.toGrothendieck_mono
+      Scheme.propQCPrecoverage_le_precoverage
+
+private theorem etaleCover_doubleProjection_comp_base
+    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
+    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
+    let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
+      Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
+    let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
+      Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
+    let g : Spec (.of E.Carrier) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
+    d₀.left ≫ g = d₁.left ≫ g := by
+  dsimp only
+  let f : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier :=
+    (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k
+  let d : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A := Over.overSpecMap f
+  let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
+    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
+  let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
+    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
+  have hcomp :
+      (doubleInl (k := k) E).comp f =
+        (doubleInr (k := k) E).comp f := by
+    ext r
+    simp [f, doubleInl, doubleInr]
+  have hover : d₀ ≫ d = d₁ ≫ d := by
+    dsimp only [d₀, d₁, d]
+    rw [← Over.overSpecMap_comp, ← Over.overSpecMap_comp, hcomp]
+  have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hover
+  have hf : f.toRingHom = algebraMap A E.Carrier := rfl
+  simpa only [Over.comp_left, d₀, d₁, d, Over.overSpecMap_left, hf,
+    overSpec_left] using hleft
+
+set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
+/-- The Pic0 Sigma functor satisfies descent for the singleton scheme cover attached to a
+presented etale algebra cover. -/
+theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleCover
+    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
+    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
+    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
+    Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
+      (.singleton (Spec.map
+        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))) := by
+  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton]
+  rintro ⟨b, x⟩ hx
+  let g : Spec (.of E.Carrier) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
+    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
+  letI : Surjective g :=
+    ⟨E.comap_surjective⟩
+  haveI : Etale g := by
+    dsimp [g]
+    rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
+    exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
+  have hbase : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p₁ p₂ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)),
+      p₁ ≫ g = p₂ ≫ g → p₁ ≫ b = p₂ ≫ b := by
+    intro Z p₁ p₂ hp
+    exact congrArg Sigma.fst (hx p₁ p₂ hp)
+  let a : Spec (.of A) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
+    EffectiveEpi.desc g b hbase
+  have ha : g ≫ a = b := EffectiveEpi.fac g b hbase
+  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Spec.map_surjective a
+  algebraize [φ.hom]
+  have haφ : g ≫ Spec.map φ = b := by
+    rw [hφ]
+    exact ha
+  have hE : (overSpec k E.Carrier).hom = b := by
+    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k E.Carrier)) = b
+    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k A E.Carrier]
+    change Spec.map (φ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)) = b
+    rw [Spec.map_comp]
+    exact haφ
+  let eIso : overSpec k E.Carrier ≅ Over.mk b :=
+    Over.isoMk (Iso.refl _) hE.symm
+  let e : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ Over.mk b := eIso.hom
+  let xE : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k E.Carrier) := pic0Map C e x
+  let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
+    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
+  let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
+    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
+  have hlegs : d₀.left ≫ g = d₁.left ≫ g := by
+    exact etaleCover_doubleProjection_comp_base E
+  have hd₀e : (d₀ ≫ e).left = d₀.left := by
+    simp only [Over.comp_left, e, eIso, Over.isoMk_hom_left, Iso.refl_hom]
+    exact Category.comp_id _
+  have hd₁e : (d₁ ≫ e).left = d₁.left := by
+    simp only [Over.comp_left, e, eIso, Over.isoMk_hom_left, Iso.refl_hom]
+    exact Category.comp_id _
+  have hSigma :
+      (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map (d₀ ≫ e).left.op ⟨b, x⟩ =
+        (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map (d₁ ≫ e).left.op ⟨b, x⟩ := by
+    rw [hd₀e, hd₁e]
+    exact hx d₀.left d₁.left hlegs
+  have hFib := Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq
+    (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) (d₀ ≫ e) (d₁ ≫ e) hSigma
+  have hdouble :
+      pic0Map C d₀ xE = pic0Map C d₁ xE := by
+    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d₀.op
+        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x) =
+      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d₁.op
+        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x)
+    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply]
+    exact hFib
+  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzu⟩ :=
+    pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_etaleCover C E xE hdouble
+  let d : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A :=
+    Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
+  let q : Over.mk b ⟶ overSpec k A := Over.homMk g haφ
+  have heq : e ≫ q = d := by
+    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
+    rfl
+  have hrestrict (t : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A)) :
+      pic0Map C e (pic0Map C q t) = pic0Map C d t := by
+    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
+        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op t) =
+      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d.op t
+    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, heq]
+  have hq : pic0Map C q z = x := by
+    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
+      ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op)).1
+    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
+        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op z) =
+      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x
+    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, heq]
+    change pic0Map C d z = xE
+    exact hz
+  refine ⟨⟨Spec.map φ, z⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · refine (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff
+      (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) g haφ z x).mpr ?_
+    rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply]
+    exact hq
+  · rintro ⟨a', z'⟩ hz'
+    have ha' : a' = Spec.map φ := by
+      exact (EffectiveEpi.uniq g b hbase a'
+        (congrArg Sigma.fst hz')).trans hφ.symm
+    subst a'
+    change pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A) at z'
+    refine congrArg (Sigma.mk (Spec.map φ)) (hzu z' ?_)
+    have hq' : pic0Map C q z' = x := by
+      have hmem := (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff
+        (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) g haφ z' x).mp hz'
+      rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hmem
+      exact hmem
+    calc
+      pic0Map C d z' = pic0Map C e (pic0Map C q z') := (hrestrict z').symm
+      _ = pic0Map C e x := congrArg (pic0Map C e) hq'
+      _ = xE := rfl
+
+/-- Singleton descent for the Pic0 Sigma functor along an arbitrary surjective etale map
+between affine schemes.  The base-field algebra structures and a small presented cover are
+chosen internally. -/
+theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleSingleton
+    {k : Type u} [Field k]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
+    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
+    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S)
+    (hf : Etale (Spec.map f)) (hs : Surjective (Spec.map f)) :
+    Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
+      (.singleton (Spec.map f)) := by
+  algebraize [f.hom]
+  haveI : Algebra.Etale R S :=
+    RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mp
+      ((HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hf)
+  have hcomap :
+      Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) := by
+    exact (surjective_iff (Spec.map f)).mp hs
+  let E : Algebra.EtaleCover R := Algebra.EtaleCover.of S hcomap
+  let e : Spec S ≅ Spec (.of E.Carrier) :=
+    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
+      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op
+  have he : e.hom ≫
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R E.Carrier)) =
+      Spec.map f := by
+    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
+        (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).toRingEquiv.toRingHom) ≫
+      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
+        (algebraMap R (Algebra.EtaleCover.of S hcomap).Carrier)) =
+      Spec.map f
+    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
+    congr 1
+    ext r
+    exact (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).commutes r
+  exact (Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton_iff_of_iso
+    (Spec.map f)
+    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R E.Carrier))) e he).mpr
+      (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleCover C E)
+
+/-- The raw Pic0 Sigma functor is a sheaf for the big etale topology. -/
+theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale
+    {k : Type u} [Field k]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
+    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
+    Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) := by
+  rw [Scheme.etaleTopology_eq_propQCTopology,
+    isSheaf_type_propQCTopology_iff]
+  exact ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf C,
+    fun f hf hs =>
+      pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleSingleton C f hf hs⟩
+
+/-- The categorical sheaf certificate associated to raw big-etale Pic0 Sigma descent. -/
+theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_presheafIsSheaf_etale
+    {k : Type u} [Field k]
+    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
+    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
+    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) :=
+  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
+    (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale C)
+
+end
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry
